recipes.notes: This is a source-verified reconstruction overlay, not canonical exact geometry. Coordinates are modern locator points for historically identified landmarks/areas. They may be edited independently as research improves; generated geometry must rebuild from this recipe.

anchors.label: Устье Сестры
anchors.treatyContext: Начало границы у Сестры на Финском заливе
anchors.locatorBasis: Modern mouth area of the Sestra at Sestroretsk; treaty and later boundary descriptions identify the Sestra as the starting natural feature.

anchors.label: Илмее — кластер южных межевых ориентиров
anchors.treatyContext: Район плотной последовательности ориентиров южного участка
anchors.locatorBasis: Modern Ilmee area used as a locator for the dense Pehkeensuo/Kangaslampi/Purnujärvi/Aitjärvi/Torsajärvi landscape discussed in historical-geography reconstruction; not itself a treaty point.

anchors.label: Торсаярви
anchors.locatorBasis: Approximate modern Torsajärvi locator; retained as an interpretation anchor pending higher-precision historical georeferencing.

anchors.label: Сиитинселькя / Жити
anchors.treatyContext: Северная оконечность основной заселённой части новгородской территории в реконструкции
anchors.locatorBasis: Common scholarly identification of treaty Zhity/Siti with the Siitinselkä area south of Varkaus.

anchors.label: Карьяланкоски / Колимакоски
anchors.treatyContext: Один из немногих ориентиров дальнего северного участка
anchors.locatorBasis: Scholarly identification of the treaty place-name with the Karjalankoski area; sparse surrounding documentary control points require broad uncertainty.

anchors.label: Пюхяйоки — вероятная Патоеки
anchors.treatyContext: Предполагаемый конечный выход границы к Ботническому заливу
anchors.locatorBasis: Shaskolsky considers the Pyhäjoki identification the most plausible among competing readings, but the endpoint remains historically debated.

segments.note: Condensed display of the comparatively well-localized southern sequence; individual intermediate treaty landmarks remain to be geocoded.
The treaty becomes much more sparsely marked north of the main settled territory.
